headline: Review of GMP with Turnstone, a rep's authority to sign change orders, and a road repair quote at Evergreen & Edgewood.
summary: The meeting will review a GMP with Turnstone and discuss a quote for road repair. It will also discuss appointing a representative to sign change orders up to a set dollar amount without board approval.
items: Discuss appointing a representative to sign off on change orders up to a certain dollar amount without Board approval
Discuss quote for road repair at Evergreen & Edgewood
Any old or new business that may come before the board

CITY OF NASHUA                NEW HAMPSHIRE 
 
TRUSTEES OF 
     THE EDGEWOOD/SUBURBAN CEMETERIES 
Incorporated March 24, 1893 
 
                                                            October 23,2026    
                                                          
 
 
Edgewood/Suburban Cemetery Trustees, 
 
 
 
There will be an Edgewood/Suburban Cemetery Meeting on  
October 28,2026 at 3:30PM in the Cemetery Chapel. 
 
 
 
                                                         Agenda 
 
 
 
1. Call meeting to order. 
2. Attendance. 
3. Approval of minutes from the August 26,2026 meeting. 
4. Notice of meeting. 
5. GMP Review with Turnstone. 
6. Discuss to appoint a rep to have authority to sign off on                                                              
      change orders up to a certain $ amount without Board approval. 
7.  Discuss quote for road repair at Evergreen & Edgewood.      
8. Any old or new business that may come before the board. 
9. Adjourn.
